newsitem.title: UK: LPC -One-2-One boosts funds capacity to 2.2bln stg.
newsitem.headline: LPC -One-2-One boosts funds capacity to 2.2bln stg.

text.p: LONDON, September 9 (LPC) - Mercury One-2-One today said it has increased its available funding capacity to 2.2 billion stg.
The funding comprises one billion stg from shareholders Cable and Wireless and US West Inc and a 1.2 billion stg syndicated loan.
Arrangers of the senior debt -- Banque Paribas, HSBC Investment Bank and Citibank International -- have brought 12 additional banks into the credit, an oversubscription of 50 percent.
The credit, which is to go into general syndication later this week, has an eight year final maturity and is priced 150 bps over LIBOR.

Banks joining the deal include Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Royal Bank of Scotland, Credit Lyonnais, Societe Generale, Fuji Bank, Toronto-Dominion Bank, Bank of New York, CIBC Wood Gundy, Barclays Bank, Sumitomo Bank, Deutsche Bank and ABN AMRO Bank.
The bank loan has no recourse to shareholders but is secured by the One-2-One business.
As part of the funding exercise, Mercury shareholders will contribute during the next two to three years 355 million stg in addition to the 645 million stg already invested.

"This funding ensures that we are in a competitive position to grow both our customer base and revenues, financing an aggressive marketing programme in new and core areas and opening up new distribution...," said One-2-One managing director Jan Peters.
